India API sample document This two-page PDF is a sample for the PDF tools of India API. Send it to the endpoints to read its details and text, take its pages apart, rotate them, merge it with another PDF or draw a page as a picture. The second page holds text in Tamil and Hindi, to show that text in Indian scripts comes through intact. Page two வணக்கம். இது இந்தியா API-இன் மாதிரி ஆவணம். नमस्ते। यह इंडिया API का नमूना दस्तावेज़ है। Thank you for trying it.
